facts.business: NLC India Limited is engaged in lignite mining and power generation, operating as a mining and power company with social responsiveness accelerating the nation's growth.

capacity_or_capex.item: Investment in NLC India Green Energy Limited (NIGEL)
Investment in NLC Rajasthan Power Limited (NRPL)

auditor.name: Independent Auditors (not explicitly named in excerpt)
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Material Uncertainty Related to Going Concern due to non-availability of adequate lignite mining land at Neyveli mines; Emphasis of Matter on VSVS billing to DISCOMs sub judice, provisional tariff recognition for power sales, and regulatory deferral account balances.

key_risks: Non-availability of adequate lignite mining land at Neyveli mines casting significant uncertainty on operations and going concern
Revenue recognition subject to provisional tariff orders pending final CERC tariff determination
Regulatory deferral account balances dependent on future tariff regulations and recoverability
Disputed VSVS billing to DISCOMs sub judice with retained regulatory deferral liability
Impairment risks across investments in joint ventures and expected credit losses on financial assets
facts.related_party_note: Inter-company loan of ₹513.35 Crore outstanding to NLC India Renewables Limited (NIRL) from JPY ECB proceeds on cost-to-cost basis; loans to employees at fair value; investments in subsidiaries and joint ventures with nominee shareholding by directors.
